prediction_task: Classify broad ISCO-08 occupational families of employed adults, NOT student aptitude or next skill
source: OECD PIAAC Cycle 2 (2023), five-country anonymous employed respondents

metrics.split: Stratified random 80/20; random_state=42; preprocessing fitted on train only
metrics.note: Random test split reused during earlier exploratory benchmarks; final test numbers are not independent model-selection evidence.

training.method: 3-fold stratified CV on train only, optimize macro-F1 across two pre-specified iteration counts; fit selected model on complete training partition; evaluate on 20% test.

limitations: Broad occupation families, not exact job titles
Workers data, not outcomes of learning interventions
Self-reported workplace skill use does not equal mastery
Softmax values are uncalibrated model class scores, not hiring probabilities
Holdout already used in exploratory comparisons and may give optimistic model-selection impression
No causal inference; does not predict the best next course
